title: Portfolio Manager
description: Decision support per strategy, from the PM Knowledge Base vault: review signals (P0/P1/P2), executable value, convexity class, gamma/theta efficiency, journal history. Never trades.

panels.title: P0 hard
panels.description: Thesis invalid, risk budget breached or data unreliable (vault: exit_signals).

panels.title: P1 time / profit
panels.description: Profit levels, DTE window, short leg near expiry.

panels.title: P2 drift / efficiency
panels.description: Delta, class change, GT_h below 1, low remaining reward.

panels.title: Data flags
panels.description: Strategies with a missing, stale or wide quote, or no greeks: their outcome is REVIEW - data unreliable.

panels.title: Cost to close all now
panels.description: Mid value minus executable value (sell at the bid, buy back at the ask), summed over strategies with quotes.

panels.title: Review queue (every strategy not on HOLD, highest priority first)
panels.description: The Portfolio Manager's review signals (vault rules) next to what the bot's own rules say. Click a strategy for its detail below. Manager: long options (opened for a debit) or short options (opened for a credit), not the convexity class. Review at DTE is the long manager's life-scaled window; Captured is the short manager's share of the credit kept.

targets.expr: sum by (strategy, symbol, kind, manager, cls, outcome, top, signals, bot) (thetagang_pm_info{outcome!="HOLD"})

properties.value: The vault's DTE review window for this strategy's original life (T3).

targets.expr: sum by (strategy, structure, kind, manager, cls, outcome, bot) (thetagang_pm_info{strategy="$strategy"})

panels.title: Executable value
panels.description: Sell long legs at the bid, buy back shorts at the ask.

panels.title: GT 5-day
panels.description: Long convexity only: expected gamma gain over 5 trading days / theta paid, at forecast realised vol. Below 1: decay beats gamma (vault: gamma_theta_efficiency).

panels.title: Breakeven vol vs realised
panels.description: sigma_BE: the realised volatility at which gamma pays for theta over 5 days, vs the 21-day realised vol forecast. Long convexity wins when realised > breakeven.

panels.title: Remaining reward / risk
panels.description: (best value at expiry - executable value) / (executable value - worst value at expiry). Defined-risk strategies only.

panels.title: Worst-case loss
panels.description: Phase 1 proxy: executable value down to the worst value at expiry. Phase 2: the scenario grid's worst cell. Compared with your max_loss.

panels.title: Thesis and budget (journal)
panels.description: Your inputs come from [[pm.strategies]] in the TOML (by strategy ID). Positions held before the journal started have an estimated entry.

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_char(entry_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "Entry", CASE WHEN entry_estimated THEN 'estimated' ELSE '' END AS " ", net_debit AS "Net debit ($)", initial_dte AS "DTE at entry", thesis AS "Thesis", invalidation_below AS "Invalid below", invalidation_above AS "Invalid above", target AS "Target ($)", max_loss AS "Max loss ($)", thesis_valid AS "Thesis valid", status AS "Status" FROM strategies WHERE id = '$strategy'
SELECT day::timestamptz AS time, pnl_exec AS "executable", pnl_mid AS "mid" FROM snapshots WHERE strategy_id = '$strategy' AND $__timeFilter(day::timestamptz) ORDER BY day

panels.title: Decision log
panels.description: One row each time this strategy's outcome or signals changed.

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_char(at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "When (NY)", outcome AS "PM outcome", (SELECT string_agg((e->>'priority') || ' ' || (e->>'name') || ': ' || (e->>'detail'), '; ')  FROM jsonb_array_elements(signals) e) AS "Signals", bot_action AS "Bot rules said", your_action AS "You did" FROM decisions WHERE strategy_id = '$strategy' ORDER BY at DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Legs (journal)
panels.description: Open legs first; closed legs show the roll history.

targets.rawSql: SELECT label AS "Contract", qty AS "Qty", entry_price AS "Entry price", to_char(opened_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "Opened", to_char(closed_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "Closed" FROM strategy_legs WHERE strategy_id = '$strategy' ORDER BY closed_on IS NOT NULL, closed_on DESC, label

panels.title: Executable value by underlying (concentration)
panels.description: Sum of |executable value| of each underlying's strategies (vault: portfolio_management).

panels.title: Strategies with unreliable data
panels.description: Missing, crossed, stale or wide quotes, zero bids, no greeks (vault: data_quality_controls). Before the open most options show here.

panels.title: Trading rules in use ([pm] in the TOML)
panels.description: The settings that decide reviews and the bot's roll/close orders: profit, DTE, delta, efficiency and loss levels for both managers, and decide. Each with its vault register ID (assumptions_register; all hypotheses) and whether it is the default or your [pm] setting. Model and data settings (T7 tolerances, T9 quote limits, M1, M6), the superseded T2 and journal still act from the TOML but are not listed. Change them in the TOML and restart the monitor.

targets.expr: sum by (name, value, vault_id, source, meaning) (thetagang_pm_param{vault_id!~"T2|T7|T9|M[0-9]+", name!="journal"})

panels.title: Credit captured (short options)
panels.description: Share of the credit kept: (credit - cost to buy back now) / credit, at executable prices. S1: 50% review, 70% strong consideration, 80% default close, 90-100% normally close. Strategies opened for a credit only.

panels.title: Loss multiple (short options)
panels.description: (cost to buy back now - credit) / credit: 0 at breakeven, 1 when the loss equals the credit, negative in profit. S3 reviews at 1x / 2x / 3x. Strategies opened for a credit only.

panels.title: Premium left per $ of risk (short options)
panels.description: Remaining premium / remaining risk = cost to buy back now / worst-case loss (phase 1: down to the expiry floor, defined risk only). It falls late in a trade: each extra $ of premium costs more risk. Strategies opened for a credit only.
